# source_path = 3811316052/common/scripted_effects/myv_wyvern_effects.txt
# source_sha256 = cad02cac285f8b7cc36c3b3bb9d726fec44cfb09ecd51ad47928322f96bbe396
myv_slay_create_trophy_effect = {
    random_list = {
        65 = {
            if = {
                limit = { scope:myv_slay_wyvern_target = { var:myv_wyvern_size >= 240 } }
                create_artifact = {
                    name = myv_wyvern_fang_name
                    description = myv_wyvern_fang_desc
                    type = miscellaneous
                    visuals = myv_wyvern_fang
                    rarity = illustrious
                    modifier = artifact_monthly_prestige_4_modifier
                    modifier = artifact_dread_baseline_add_3_modifier
                    creator = root
                    decaying = no
                    save_scope_as = myv_wyvern_trophy
                }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { scope:myv_slay_wyvern_target = { var:myv_wyvern_size >= 150 } }
                create_artifact = {
                    name = myv_wyvern_fang_name
                    description = myv_wyvern_fang_desc
                    type = miscellaneous
                    visuals = myv_wyvern_fang
                    rarity = famed
                    modifier = artifact_monthly_prestige_3_modifier
                    modifier = artifact_dread_baseline_add_2_modifier
                    creator = root
                    decaying = no
                    save_scope_as = myv_wyvern_trophy
                }
            }
            else = {
                create_artifact = {
                    name = myv_wyvern_fang_name
                    description = myv_wyvern_fang_desc
                    type = miscellaneous
                    visuals = myv_wyvern_fang
                    rarity = masterwork
                    modifier = artifact_monthly_prestige_2_modifier
                    modifier = artifact_dread_baseline_add_1_modifier
                    creator = root
                    decaying = no
                    save_scope_as = myv_wyvern_trophy
                }
            }
        }
        20 = {
            create_artifact = {
                name = myv_wyvern_scale_name
                description = myv_wyvern_scale_desc
                type = miscellaneous
                visuals = myv_wyvern_scale
                rarity = illustrious
                modifier = artifact_monthly_minor_prestige_5_modifier
                creator = root
                decaying = no
                save_scope_as = myv_wyvern_trophy
            }
			scope:myv_wyvern_trophy = {
				set_variable = { name = myv_wyvern_scale_material value = 1 }
			}
        }
        15 = {
            create_artifact = {
                name = myv_wyvern_blood_name
                description = myv_wyvern_blood_desc
                type = miscellaneous
                visuals = myv_wyvern_blood
                rarity = illustrious
                modifier = artifact_monthly_minor_prestige_5_modifier
                creator = root
                decaying = no
                save_scope_as = myv_wyvern_trophy
            }
			scope:myv_wyvern_trophy = {
				set_variable = { name = myv_wyvern_blood_material value = 1 }
			}
        }
    }

    send_interface_toast = {
        type = event_toast_effect_good
        title = myv_wyvern_trophy_gained_toast
        left_icon = scope:myv_wyvern_trophy
    }
    myv_slay_try_find_wyvern_eggs_effect = yes
}
